author: Hero Hei
description:
YouTuber Mtashed, known for his Genshin videos, decided to call out Asmogold the other day which Asmon responded to. Well, over the last 24 hours or so, it seems Mtashed ended up deleting almost every video from his channel. Let's take a look at the video and what's going on here.

Update: since then MTashed has begun restoring certain videos on his channel and even posted a public response video that seems to be about Asmongold and Tectone. In this stream we'll take a look at the latest and what he has to say.
title: Asmongold vs Mtashed 2 (he deleted THEN responded)
